newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah weakens on ample supply.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah weakens on ample supply.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah weakened against the dollar in slow late trading on Monday due to sustained ample liquidity, dealers said.
"We had already expected the local currency to weaken further in late trading as rupiah liquidity remained ample," one foreign bank dealer said.
Spot rupiah was last quoted at 2,396.00/96.40 at 0830 GMT against 2,395.25/96.00 at the opening. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,395.90/95.35 and 2,395.15/95.50 respectively.
The dealer said the rupiah was expected to remain weak on Tuesday as the ample liquidity was likely to continue.
Dealers said short-term and longer-term swaps had generally eased on ample rupiah supply.
Overnight swap was quoted at par/0.05, down from 0.10/0.20 at the opening and tom/next fell to 0.05/0.07 from an opening of 0.10/0.20.
Dealers said Bank Indonesia governor's announcement to sell the central bank's stakes in several commercial banks had more impact on the local stock exchange than on the foreign exchange market.
One-month swaps were at 10.00/10.50, two at 23.0/24.00, three at 36.00/36.50 and six at 75.0/76.00 points.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,386/2,578 and the conversion band also by one point to 2,386/2,434 on Monday.
